biggest_catch: The promotion is time-bound: referred new members must apply between June 1, 2026 and December 31, 2026, and you get nothing until the friend establishes full membership - plus membership eligibility is limited to entertainment industry employees/guild members and existing members.
catches: Refer friends or coworkers and earn $100 for each referral who becomes a member; up to $500 per year (5 referrals max).

Referred new members must submit a membership application between June 1, 2026 and December 31, 2026 to be eligible; eligibility requirements must all be met within 30 calendar days of establishing membership.
The $100 referral bonus is credited to the referring member's First500 Savings Account within 30 days after the last business day of the month the referred member meets all membership requirements.
Membership eligibility: employees and members of approved entertainment companies, studios, and guilds, plus existing members and invited applicants.
Taxes on bonuses are the member's responsibility and may be reported to the IRS; First Entertainment employees, volunteers, and their immediate family are not eligible.
No payout for referring whoever referred you.
